text:
eve_lead: Heads up — all-hands in 5. Small agenda adjustment: move 'international regions' to the end, put roadmap Q&A right after intros. Also captioning looked laggy in the last dry-run; can ops confirm encoder + local recorder status?

sam_ops: On it. Swapping to backup encoder now. OBS scene -> `AllHands_LowLatency`. Starting local recording to /mnt/rec/allhands-1749994321.mp4 :thumbsup:

devops-bot: recorder status -> starting (PID 4231), writing to /mnt/rec/allhands-1749994321.mp4

maria_prod: Heads-up for leadership: I'll surface two roadmap asks during Q&A — (1) Dedicated GPU region expansion timeline; (2) autofailover for Private deploy rollouts. Can @ana_ceo confirm expected SLAs so I can phrase the ask?

ana_ceo: For (1) target pilot in eu-west by end of Q3. For (2) aim for 99.9% uptime for Dedicated; Private will need contract-dependent SLAs — we can clarify in the Q&A. I'll be on the call.

sam_ops: Encoder swapped to alt-hw, running captions smoke test. Seeing a small stutter on the captions stream, sending manifest to captions team now. ffmpeg snippet I used: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://live -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 4500k -f flv rtmp://backup```

jules_relay: Monitoring OBS + local rec. If live transcoder drops, fallback route set to standby-host-2. Heads-up: there's potential feedback from stage mics at ~00:03 — recommend muting stage mics right before intros.

eve_lead: Copy. @jules_relay mute at 00:03 please. @sam_ops confirm when captions are green so I can announce.

sam_ops: Captions green, end-to-end latency ~1.2s, local recording writing and checksum OK, fallback ready. :white_check_mark:

maria_prod: Quick follow-up: we'll publish the roadmap slides after the meeting — want to confirm post-all-hands action item and owner.

ana_ceo: Yes — slides + short recap will be published within 24 hrs. I'll follow up on timeline owners in this thread after the meeting.

eve_lead: Thanks team. If anything degrades, post here or ping me directly. Starting intros in 2 minutes.
